bone: Raw cream. The marketing site's page ground. In components use surface, which adapts.
bone-2: Raw deeper cream. In components use surface-sunk.
paper: Raw lightest cream. Text on ink and on the feature Card in light. In components use surface-raised.
ink: Raw warm near-black. Text on bone, bone-2 and paper; the ground of the site's dark section and the feature Card in light.
ink-2: Raw softer ink. Secondary text on bone and paper on the marketing site.
muted: Raw warm grey. Tertiary text on bone and paper on the marketing site. In components use fg-muted.
pine-1: Deepest forest green. The pines are a depth scale for brand artwork, not states.
pine-3: Forest green, mid step. Link colour on the marketing site, on bone.
pine-4: Forest green, fourth step. The selected Tab's underline. Meets 3:1 on surface in light; 2.8:1 on the dark surface, kept as the source has it.
gold: The crown. Fill of the brand Button and of the Logo's crown, and the 2px focus ring on every control. Not a text colour on light surfaces (2.8:1 on bone).
gold-bright: Crown highlight. Kickers and links on ink, and on the feature Card in light.
gold-deep: Crown shadow. Mono kickers and eyebrows on surface, surface-sunk and surface-raised, and the brand Button's hover fill. 4.5:1 or better on the light surfaces; the source uses it for kickers in dark too, where it is 2.2 to 3.3:1.
gold-1: Bright ramp, lightest. Accents and highlights; sandbox banner text in dark.
gold-5: Bright ramp, deepest. Sandbox banner text in light.
surface: Page background, and the fill of inputs.
surface-sunk: Recessed areas: the Sidenav, table headers, inline code, the sunk Card.
surface-raised: Raised areas: Cards, Panels, tables, the Drawer.
surface-translucent: The AppNav's fill, over a 14px backdrop blur.
fg: Primary text and headings, on surface, surface-sunk and surface-raised.
fg-2: Body copy and table cells, on surface, surface-sunk and surface-raised.
fg-muted: Secondary text, hints and table headers, on surface, surface-sunk and surface-raised. 4.7:1 or better in light. In dark it is 4.9:1 on surface-sunk, 4.0:1 on surface and 3.4:1 on surface-raised, kept as the source has it.
rule: Hairline borders on controls: inputs, line Buttons, outline Cards.
rule-2: Fainter hairline: Card and Panel borders, table row dividers.
hover-overlay: Wash laid over a row or a quiet button on hover.
primary: Fill of the primary Button: the one dominant action on a surface.
primary-hover: The primary Button's fill on hover.
primary-fg: Text on primary. 7.8:1 in light. In dark it is 4.5:1 on primary and 3.6:1 on primary-hover, kept as the source has it.
danger: Destructive actions and refusals: the danger Button's text and border, negative amounts, an out-of-balance trial balance. As text on surface and surface-raised it is 5.2:1 or better in light and 3.0 to 3.6:1 in dark, kept as the source has it.
danger-hover: The solid danger Button's fill on hover.
danger-fg: Text on danger. 5.6:1 in light; 4.0:1 in dark, kept as the source has it.
pos: Credits and positive amounts, as text on surface and surface-raised. Paired with danger for debits.
brand-action: Fill of the brand Button: publishing and other brand-coded actions.
brand-action-hover: The brand Button's fill on hover.
brand-action-fg: Text on brand-action, 5.8:1. On brand-action-hover it is 3.3:1, kept as the source has it.
gl-control-bg: GlClass chip, control: a sub-ledger rollup. The gold accent.
gl-summary-bg: GlClass chip, summary: a structural parent.
gl-detail-bg: GlClass chip, detail: a posting leaf.
debit: The debit leg's dot in the trial balance. Warm, matching the debit-normal GlType chips.
credit: The credit leg's dot in the trial balance. Cool, matching the credit-normal GlType chips.
ok: The trial balance's In balance line and icon, on surface-raised. 6.6:1 in light; 4.2:1 in dark, kept as the source has it.
sandbox-bg: Fill of the SandboxBanner. Used for nothing else.
